physicalDetails.detail: Gender never established: referred to only as 'the fourth' / 'the fourth ranger'; no pronouns used. Keep ungendered.

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Escort Neral and the girl to the Pass, leading the spare grey.

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Turned toward the bridge before being told and held it ('Nothing comes over it from either side till I call'); later held the bridge with Lyriel; stood the first night watch (gallery and yard gate) with Lyriel; brought the girl out to the horses at departure; mounted holding the spare grey's lead short in one hand and rode north behind Neral.

abilitiesDemonstrated.ability: Reliable and self-starting: Sylvanas notes 'the one she had never once had to think about all down the hill road'.

howOthersAddressThem.speaker: Sylvanas
howOthersAddressThem.pattern: 'the fourth' / 'the fourth ranger' in order and thought; never a name.

arc.currentPosition: Rides north with Neral; leaves the southbound party. Ch4 opens with exactly four south (Sylvanas, Jaina, Cyndia, Lyriel).
